items.actClause: AN ACT to continue the existence of the village of Groton industrial development agency
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4798

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to continue the existence of the village of
Groton industrial development agency

 PURPOSE :

To extend and clarify in statute the existence of the Groton IDA

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1 is a declaratory paragraph that the Groton village IDA,
created by the General Municipal Law, shall continue and shall have
been in existence since July 2003. Section 2 provides for the
effective date.

 EXISTING LAW :

The law authorizing the IDA's existence lapsed in 2003.

 JUSTIFICATION :

The legislation has been requested by the village of Groton pursuant
to its home rule authority. The village has had an IDA since 1983,
when established by section 926-i of the GML. It was renewed in 1993
for another ten years (chaper 364 of the Laws of 1993). While the
legislative authority for the IDA seemingly lapsed, it has continued
its operations and has filed every report required by the Authorities
Budget Office. IDAs can play a valuable role in local economic and
industrial development, and the local government has requested the
continuation of this additional economic development tool. When it was
brought to the village's attention that the legislative authority for
the IDA had lapsed, village officials immediately sought legislative
assistance to validate and continue the IDA's operation.

This is a "housekeeping" measure that essentially validates the IDA's
existence and extends its duration.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the state

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediate

summary: Continues the existence of the Groton industrial development agency.
